product.name: Monoprice Microphone Stand with Hand-Clutch & Solid Base
product.description: Seamlessly adjust the height of your microphone with this Microphone Stand with Hand-Clutch from Monoprice.This microphone stand was designed with you in mind and is built the quality you have come to expect from Monoprice. It features a solid round base that measures 9.6" in diameter for excellent stability. It also features a convenient hand-clutch for one-handed adjustment. Using the hand-clutch the stand can be easily adjusted from a collpased height of 35" all the way up to 58".Microphone clip sold separately.
